headline: A soft quarter, margin recovery ahead

highlights: Inox Green’s O&M portfolio stood at 12.5GWp, as it discontinued some solar contracts because of lower margins.
Management highlighted a strong pipeline of 5GW over the next 4-5 months.
INXW also stands to benefit from orders from Inox Clean (group company).
However, it reported a soft quarter, with EBITDA margin contracting 520bps YoY to 15.1% because of raw material inflation, resulting in EBITDA of INR 2bn (-10% YoY) and PAT of INR 0.7bn (-43% YoY).
